implementation_summary: Completed T033-R1 rework after fast-forwarding local develop to exact origin/develop c48880262d6d4e98e734932b5bcc6687db0791e0 and cleanly merging that revision into the preserved existing T033 history. The accepted portability implementation remains: supported POSIX hosts use flock, native Windows uses a deterministic fail-closed per-EXCHANGE Win32 named mutex, checkout LF policy is repository-controlled, canonical LF fixtures are explicit, and artifact ordering uses canonical relative POSIX strings. R1 removes every symlink_or_skip acceptance weakening. When ordinary Windows symlink creation is unavailable with WinError 1314, the tests now create an unprivileged NTFS junction fixture and execute the same unsafe-link/collision/source-marker claims; production classifies both symbolic links and junctions as unsafe and fails closed. The fresh native-Windows canonical suite completes with 325 passed and zero skips. No Markdown blob, T021 implementation, Governance/RCAB semantics, digest/byte expectation, dependency, or package boundary changed.
